data.description: Pearl Jumeirah offers the seclusion of a desert island with a strong link to the city.

data.answer:
This prestigious neighborhood is one of the freehold areas in Dubai that allows both locals and expatriates to own property. With its prime location just off the coast of Jumeirah’s mainland, Pearl Jumeirah provides a tranquil escape from the city's bustle while remaining connected to all major attractions and business districts in Dubai.

The Pearl Jumeirah project by Meraas was developed between 2009 and 2011. The community is conveniently equipped with all urban amenities and is situated near the borders of Al Badaa and Al Mina. This development is seamlessly connected to the mainland through a comprehensive network of arterial roads.

In Pearl Jumeirah, the majority of properties are composed of over 300 residential plots, allowing owners to build their villas in compliance with Jumeirah's building regulations. The area permits the construction of Ground+1 level buildings and allows a built-up area (BUA) of 70% of the plot size. Additionally, there are no design or architectural restrictions, giving owners considerable freedom in how they develop their properties.

Pearl Jumeirah stands out as one of the few areas in Dubai offering freehold residential plots, making it possible for expatriates to invest in real estate and build homes. Notably, the neighborhood features the Nikki Beach Resort, where private residences come equipped with amenities like private swimming pools and gyms.

Residents are also just a short walk from Nikki Spa by ESPA, the club, Cafe Nikki, and Modern Tone Gym, offering a luxurious and convenient lifestyle. The Pearl Jumeirah beach itself offers a diverse range of residential options, including 1-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom apartments, a 4-bedroom penthouse, and 4-bedroom townhouses, catering to various preferences and needs within a lavish 5-star resort setting.

Renting a Property in Pearl Jumeirah

At Nikki Resort in Pearl Jumeirah, you can find 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units with annual rental rates beginning at AED 255k for a spacious 1,141 sq. ft. one-bedroom apartment.

This apartment includes a master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, an additional guest bathroom, a lounge that extends to a balcony, and up to two parking spaces. Rental prices for 2-bedroom apartments range from AED 360k to AED 650k, and 3-bedroom apartments are available for AED 220k per annum.

Buying a Property in Pearl Jumeirah Area Dubai

When it comes to purchasing options, the price of apartments for sale varies depending on size, type, and view. In Pearl Jumeirah, 1-bedroom apartments are available for AED 2.8M, 2-bedroom apartments for AED 1.78M, and 3-bedroom apartments range from AED 13.5M to AED 20.1M.

Each unit offers similar facilities and access to communal amenities. For those interested in larger spaces, Pearl Jumeirah villas for sale start at AED 21.5M, with options ranging from 4 to 8 bedrooms, and even luxurious 10-bedroom estates. The sale price for a 4-bedroom townhouse averages AED 9.1M, covering about 4,399 sq. ft., while 5 to 7-bedroom mansions are typically priced between AED 16M and AED 17M. You can also invest in Pearl Jumeirah plots for sale to get the best returns.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Pearl Jumeirah?

data.answer:
Living in Pearl Jumeirah offers a unique blend of serene island tranquility and urban luxury. This exclusive community features beautifully designed villas and apartments with stunning views of the Dubai skyline and the Arabian Gulf. Residents can enjoy a quiet, laid-back lifestyle with private beaches, lush landscapes, and a range of upscale amenities, all while being just a short drive from the vibrant heart of Dubai.

Public Transportation in Pearl Jumeirah

While Pearl Jumeirah offers limited direct access to public transportation options, residents can find the nearest bus and metro services within a 10 to 15-minute drive. The closest metro stations include the Dubai Internet City and Al Safa stations, facilitating easy access to the rest of the city.

Supermarkets in Pearl Jumeirah Dubai

Pearl Jumeirah is serviced by several supermarkets that cater to the daily needs of its residents. Waitrose and Choithrams are two major supermarkets located just outside the island, approximately a 5 to 10-minute drive away, providing a wide range of products from international to local organic foods.

Shopping Malls in and Near the Pearl Jumeirah Area

Shopping enthusiasts in Pearl Jumeirah are within a short driving distance of some of Dubai’s renowned shopping destinations. The Dubai Mall, about a 20-minute drive away, offers a comprehensive retail experience with over 1,200 stores. Closer options include City Walk and Mercato Shopping Mall, both within a 15-minute drive, offering a variety of shops, dining options, and entertainment services.

Schools and Nurseries in Pearl Jumeirah

Pearl Jumeirah is ideal for families, with several reputable schools and nurseries nearby. The English College Dubai and Jumeirah Baccalaureate School are within a 15-minute drive from the community, offering high-quality education from early years to secondary levels. For younger children, there are also multiple nurseries and early learning centers just outside the island, such as Raffles Nursery and Blossom Nursery, which are about a 10-minute drive away.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Pearl Jumeirah

Pearl Jumeirah provides easy access to various places of worship. The Jumeirah Mosque, one of Dubai’s most beautiful mosques, is approximately a 10-minute drive from Pearl Jumeirah, offering community services and guided tours. For the Christian community, St. Mary’s Catholic Church is about 15 minutes away by car. Hindu residents can reach the Shiva and Krishna temples in Bur Dubai within a 20-minute drive, catering to the spiritual needs of diverse faiths.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Pearl Jumeirah Area

Residents of Pearl Jumeirah have convenient access to several medical facilities. Medcare Hospital in Jumeirah is just a 10-minute drive away and offers a wide range of medical services and specialties. For specialized care, the Iranian Hospital on Al Wasl Road is roughly 15 minutes away by car, providing comprehensive healthcare services with advanced medical technology.

Pearl Jumeirah Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Pearl Jumeirah is strategically located just off the coast of Jumeirah’s mainland. This prime location allows for easy access to Dubai’s major highways, making it a 20-minute drive to Downtown Dubai and the Dubai International Financial Centre. The area is also approximately 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport, ensuring quick and convenient travel.

Nearby areas include the bustling Dubai Marina and the vibrant JBR area, both about a 15-minute drive away, offering a plethora of dining, shopping, and leisure activities. This ideal positioning makes Pearl Jumeirah a coveted location for both residents and investors looking for a tranquil yet connected lifestyle in Dubai.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Pearl Jumeirah

data.answer:
Pearl Jumeirah offers a plethora of activities to its residents and visitors. You can stroll along the scenic waterfront paths, enjoy a relaxing day at the community beaches, or indulge in leisure activities at the Nikki Beach Resort, which often hosts events and parties. Art enthusiasts will appreciate the local art galleries, while outdoor lovers can explore the well-maintained parks and recreational areas within the community.

Pearl Jumeirah Restaurants & Bars

Dining in Pearl Jumeirah is a delightful experience with a variety of restaurants and bars. The Nikki Beach Resort features several upscale dining options that offer everything from local to international cuisine, perfect for a luxurious dining experience by the water. Other notable spots include gourmet cafes and chic bistros dotted around the island, providing perfect settings for both casual lunches and elegant evening meals.

Beaches Near Pearl Jumeirah

Pearl Jumeirah is renowned for its beautiful and exclusive beaches that offer a perfect escape from the bustling city life. The beaches here are well-maintained with clear blue waters and fine sand, ideal for sunbathing, swimming, and various water sports. Additionally, the Nikki Beach Club on the island enhances the beach experience with its stylish sun loungers, live music, and a vibrant atmosphere.

Hotels In and Near Pearl Jumeirah Dubai

Pearl Jumeirah is home to the luxurious Nikki Beach Resort & Spa. This Pearl Jumeirah hotel provides guests with top-tier accommodations, spa services, and entertainment right on the waterfront. Nearby, the Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach and the Bulgari Hotel & Resorts Dubai offer additional opulent lodging options, each about a 15-minute drive from Pearl Jumeirah. These hotels cater to those seeking the ultimate in comfort and luxury, featuring exquisite rooms, exceptional service, and comprehensive amenities.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Pearl Jumeirah Dubai

Pearl Jumeirah is closely situated to some of Dubai’s most iconic attractions and landmarks. Just a short drive away, visitors can explore the Etihad Museum and Dubai Water Canal, each offering unique cultural and scenic experiences.

The historic area of Al Fahidi, approximately 20 minutes away, provides a glimpse into Dubai's past with its traditional architecture and museums. For more contemporary attractions, the Dubai Frame and the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, are also within a 20-minute drive, offering breathtaking views and architectural marvels.

Outdoor Activities, Salons and Gyms

For those who enjoy staying active, Pearl Jumeirah offers a range of outdoor activities. Residents can partake in water sports, enjoy cycling along dedicated paths, or engage in beach volleyball on the community beaches.

For relaxation and wellness, there are several high-end salons and spas where residents and guests can pamper themselves with a variety of treatments, such as Ivy Beauty & Bubbles Nikki Beach Resort&Spa Dubai.

Fitness enthusiasts have access to state-of-the-art gyms within the community, including those at the Nikki Beach Resort, which offer modern equipment and fitness classes to help residents maintain their health and wellness routines.

One important factor to consider before moving to Pearl Jumeirah is the cost of living. As a luxurious and exclusive residential area, the cost of property, daily expenses, and maintenance can be significantly higher than in other parts of Dubai.

This upscale community offers a high standard of living with premium amenities and services, which comes with a corresponding price tag. Prospective residents should ensure that their budget aligns with the lifestyle costs associated with Pearl Jumeirah to fully enjoy the benefits of residing in this prestigious neighborhood.

What types of properties are available in Pearl Jumeirah?

Pearl Jumeirah offers a range of luxurious residential options, including villas, townhouses, and apartments. These properties feature modern designs and high-end finishes, catering to affluent lifestyles. The area is particularly known for its spacious waterfront villas that provide privacy and exclusive access to the beach.

Are there any retail and dining options within Pearl Jumeirah?

Yes, Pearl Jumeirah hosts a variety of dining and retail options. While it's more residential, it is home to several high-end restaurants and cafes, particularly around the Nikki Beach Resort. For more extensive shopping and dining, residents often visit nearby areas such as Jumeirah Beach Road and City Walk, which are just a short drive away.

What amenities and facilities are available in Pearl Jumeirah?

Residents of Pearl Jumeirah enjoy access to a plethora of amenities including private beaches, parks, fitness centers, and children's play areas. The community is designed to offer a balanced lifestyle with a focus on wellness and leisure, making it ideal for families and individuals alike.

Where is Pearl Jumeirah located?

Pearl Jumeirah is strategically located close to major highways, providing easy access to and from the area. It’s about a 20-minute drive to Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Financial Centre, and approximately 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport. This makes it conveniently accessible while still offering a serene and private living environment.

data.content:
Pearl Jumeirah is an exclusive island development in Jumeirah 1 Dubai. It spans over 8.3 million square feet and is thoughtfully divided into residential plots, commercial spaces, beachfront villas, and a variety of community amenities.

Residents enjoy spacious properties with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline, making it an ideal setting for those seeking a serene yet upscale lifestyle.

Pearl Jumeirah hosts a range of amenities that cater to the needs of its community. These include pristine beaches, parks, and recreational areas, along with the high-end retail center, Nikki Beach Resort & Spa Dubai, which adds a touch of glamour and exclusivity.
